source_visual_observations: Isosceles triangle ABC, apexA=36°; D on AC; E midpointAB; ED perpendicularAB with right-angle box; BD drawn.
audit.independent_solution: D lies on the perpendicular bisector of AB, so AD=BD. Hence triangle ADB has angles DAB=ABD=36 degrees and ADB=108 degrees. Since A,D,C are collinear, BDC=180-108=72 degrees, choice A.
